name: CAD Digital
oneLiner: CADD is Tetra Trust's regulated Canadian dollar stablecoin, redeemable 1:1 against CAD held in trust under Alberta's Loan and Trust Corporations Act.
collateral: Canadian dollar reserves held 1:1 in trust for token holders by Tetra Trust

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Possible retained: reviewed metadata indicates direct token, vault, issuer, pause, proxy, or admin-control uncertainty, but available registry sources do not prove an active holder-balance blacklist path.

mintAuthority.summary: CADD uses ERC20F with role-gated minting and UUPS upgrades. Both ETH and Base deploy the same contract address with the same role holders: EIP-7702 delegated-account minter (0x4b37dd8b) and EIP-7702 delegated-account admin (0xb3a77dd7). EIP-7702 delegation target cannot be confirmed from chain state.

controls.label: CADD MINTER_ROLE holder (ETH and Base)
controls.evidence: RoleGranted logs on both ETH and Base confirm this address holds MINTER_ROLE (0x9f2df0fed...). eth_getCode on both chains returns prefix 0xef0100... (EIP-7702 delegated account, not a standard EOA or Safe). Delegation target unresolvable from chain state.

controls.label: CADD DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder (ETH and Base)
controls.evidence: RoleGranted logs on ETH and Base confirm DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE held by this address. eth_getCode returns 0xef0100... (EIP-7702) on both chains. Also controls UUPS upgradeToAndCall path (DEFAULT_ADMIN is upgrade authority). Delegation target unresolvable from chain state.

review.evidence: Base role holders confirmed: same addresses as Ethereum (0x4b37dd8b MINTER_ROLE, 0xb3a77dd7 DEFAULT_ADMIN). Both are EIP-7702 delegated accounts on both chains. EIP-7702 code prefix 0xef0100 confirmed on ETH and Base for both accounts. Blocker: EIP-7702 delegation target (the executing signer policy) cannot be verified from chain state — this caps confidence at manual-review.
unresolvedQuestions: EIP-7702 delegation target for both minter (0x4b37dd8b) and admin (0xb3a77dd7) cannot be resolved from chain state; custody policy (multisig, HSM, etc.) is unknown.

pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 mint and redemption of CADD for CAD through CAD Digital's regulated issuance framework

proofOfReserves.provider: Baker Tilly monthly reserve AUP report

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: CAD Digital/Tetra announced CADD as a regulated CAD stablecoin live on Base, Ethereum, and Tempo with Solana planned. No separate bridge protocol is documented in issuer materials, so the reviewed route is issuer-native multichain issuance.

milestones.title: CADD officially launches as Canada's first regulated CAD-backed stablecoin
milestones.description: Tetra Digital Group launches CADD with backing from Shopify, National Bank of Canada, ATB Financial, Wealthsimple, Shakepay, Purpose Unlimited, and Urbana Corporation; deployed on Ethereum, Base, and Tempo.

featuredContent.title: Shopify and National Bank of Canada Are Among Backers of a New Digital Currency
featuredContent.description: Canada's first regulated CAD-backed stablecoin launches with backing from Shopify, National Bank of Canada, Wealthsimple, and others.
